rules.statement: A Kandyan woman's right to an inheritance, which is a temporary joint interest, is forfeited upon marriage out in diga and does not affect a third party who has acquired the property for valuable consideration.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right that a Kandyan woman has to an inheritance is a 'temporary joint interest.' See Sawyer, p. 1. On her marriage out in diga she loses that temporary interest."
